verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a desktop Linux distribution that ships AI agents (OpenCode, Claude Code) and AI dictation, so an AI-training opt-out or privacy control is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documented control, policy, or setting that prevents user data from being used for AI model training. Mandatory disk encryption, a default firewall and local tesseract OCR are adjacent privacy features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
